framework.name: C3 Framework for Social Studies State Standards (NCSS 2013), on which the Illinois Learning Standards for Social Science are built, with the NCSS themes and Common Core literacy standards for history/social studies
framework.note: Codes are C3 Dimension 2 indicators by discipline and band (D2.Civ, D2.Geo, D2.His, e.g. D2.Civ.3.K-2), C3 inquiry indicators (D1, D3, D4), the ten NCSS themes cited by number and name, and CCSS RH/WHST literacy codes; alignment is the course author's judgment, not a certification by NCSS or ISBE.
